stages.name: refine
evidence: Issue #227 is status:ready and includes outcome, explicit household/product/maintainer/external-client stakeholders, bounded scope and exclusions, dependency on accepted #226 direction, and seven verifiable acceptance criteria.
The authorization-server placement/provider is explicitly deferred to #229 and is not necessary for this foundation slice.
WIP check at pickup: #226 is in review and no other open work items are in progress; cap 3 is respected.

stages.name: propose
evidence: Plan artifact: docs/delivery/plans/issue-227-dotnet-mcp-adapter-foundation.md. Independent reviewer approved the corrected proposal at 235e5e687b42f0f84344051e785312184483e375.

Current official SDK research: ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore 2.2.0 targets .NET 8.0 or higher, was released 2026-08-13, maps Streamable HTTP using MapMcp, and supports the 2026-07-28 protocol while retaining down-level compatibility.
Design proposes an in-process host with a DomusMind.Mcp adapter library, empty production capabilities, test-only dispatch probe, and explicit Origin-security tests.

Independent plan review requested two corrections: the existing Application project exposes transitive EF/Domain and IDomusMindDbContext, so direct reference allowlisting alone is inadequate; the actual API SPA fallback also needs MCP route exclusion and composed-host testing.

stages.name: implement
evidence: Issue #227 transitioned status:ready -> status:proposed -> status:in-progress after the independent proposal approval; WIP cap remains respected.

Implementation commit 12f17b2 adds DomusMind.Mcp, official SDK Streamable HTTP registration, empty tools/list catalog, configured Origin validation, actual API route composition with /mcp SPA fallback exclusion, Docker/solution integration, and focused SDK-client and architecture tests.

CI-equivalent restore, Release solution build, complete Release solution test, API publish, and Docker image build passed. The API project run passed 21 tests including the new MCP endpoint-composition and dependency-boundary tests; PostgreSQL-backed Infrastructure tests passed all 59 tests with the three integration tests enabled.

Architecture contract check passed; markdownlint passed across 31 docs; ProductShape architecture citation verification found 81 current citations, no stale/tampered/unresolved citations or errors, and 59 existing draft provenance warnings.

NuGet advisories remain for pre-existing Microsoft.Kiota.Abstractions 1.17.1 (NU1903) and MessagePack 2.5.302 (NU1902). Docker build also reported its legacy builder deprecation and the frontend's existing large-chunk advisory; no check failed.

Plan deviation recorded: the MCP contract and boundary tests are hosted in DomusMind.Api.Tests rather than a standalone DomusMind.Mcp.Tests project so they can exercise the real API composition and controller routes.

The proposed model remains unchanged: the host exposes no household capability; OAuth provider placement, household authorization, and production MCP tools remain deferred to their planned follow-on issues.

Live runtime verification against the built Docker image passed at 2026-10-20 05:13 UTC. A current-protocol tools/list request with configured Origin returned 200 and an empty catalog; untrusted Origin returned 403; GET /mcp returned 404 without SPA content; existing REST ping returned 200. Sanitized evidence: docs/delivery/ff/227/58591b28-0424-4eab-b1a9-9dc341adfad1/runtime.md. Task-scoped runtime and PostgreSQL containers were stopped after capture.

findings: The direct-reference plus compiled metadata boundary addresses the Application transitive dependency concern at proposal level; it is a conformance guard, not a security sandbox.
The revised plan requires testing the actual API route composition with SPA assets and excludes /mcp from fallback; tests must assert protocol-appropriate status codes and no HTML.
No scope contradiction: in-process hosting accepted, authorization-server placement remains open, and no production capabilities are added.

Application references EF Core, transitively exposes Domain, and publishes IDomusMindDbContext; add deterministic checks for both direct project/package references and compiled adapter assembly/type usage, and disclose transitive dependencies.

Stateless MCP endpoint methods interact with the API SPA fallback; test the actual API endpoint composition with static files enabled and ensure unsupported /mcp methods do not return the SPA document.

changes: Replaced the claim that an Application/Contracts project allowlist alone isolates persistence with explicit documentation of transitive EF Core/Domain references and a deterministic compiled assembly/type architecture-test boundary.
Added actual API route-composition tests with SPA assets enabled and a required /mcp fallback exclusion for unsupported verbs, preserving REST route coverage.
corrections.validation: Plan Markdown lint and git diff --check passed; ProductShape/OpenSpec artifacts were not changed.
